values.note: Suffolk County's online reservation system, with a Green Key login. Reservations 1 to 180 days ahead (no same-day). From May 15 to Oct 15 a reservation must be at least 4 nights if it takes in Thursday-Sunday and 2 nights if Monday-Wednesday only; 2 nights the rest of the season. A reservation made with the $50 Non-Resident Reservation Green Key must be at least 4 nights at any time. Sites not reserved go to walk-ups from 8 am, paid in full at check-in, at non-resident rates without a Green Key. At most 7 nights, then 7 nights away from that campground. One household per site.

booking.source: https://www.suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/Parks/Our-Parks/Southaven-County-Park ('Book a Camping Trip' -> https://www.reserveparks.suffolkcountyny.gov/) + https://www.suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/Parks/Doing-Business/Rules-and-Regulations/Campground-Rules-and-Regulations ('Reservations will be accepted from 1 to 180 days in advance'; 'Between May 15 and October 15, reservations must be for a minimum of four (4) nights (Thursday - Sunday), and for a minimum of two (2) nights (Monday - Wednesdays only, excluding holidays.) Before May 15 and after Oct. 15, the minimum is two (2) nights'; 'Check-in for available walk-up sites will begin at 8:00 am ... Full payment for walk-ups is required at check-in'; 'Campers must have a valid Green Key Card or pay non-resident rates'; 'Camping is limited to seven (7) nights maximum. Upon check-out a camper may not return to the same campground for a period of seven (7) nights') + https://suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/Parks/Things-To-Do/Camping ('Campsite occupancy strictly enforced to a single household residing at same address'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The county's in-season runs from April 1; it says off-season camping is only at Cathedral Pines and Indian Island. Its campground page gives Southaven two closings in one paragraph ('open until Veterans Day' and 'Southaven until Columbus Day'), and the 2025 camping page said all campgrounds but Smith Point closed November 1.

season.source: https://suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/Parks/Activities-and-Attractions/Camping/Campgrounds ('The Suffolk County Parks camping season generally runs from April through Veterans Day in November'; 'Blydenburgh , Cedar Point , Cupsogue , Meschutt , Montauk , Sears Bellows , Shinnecock and Southaven are open until Veterans Day. Southaven until Columbus Day and Smith Point until October 31st') + https://suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/Parks/Things-To-Do/Camping ('In Season: April 1, 2025 - November 11, 2025'; 'off-season camping is only allowed at Cathedral Pines and Indian Island. All campgrounds will close on November 1, 2025, with the exception of Smith Point'), read 2026-10-21

note: Suffolk County park on the Carmans River; loops set back in pine-oak woods. --Claude
summary: County pages: confirmed 104 sites (53 basic + 51 electric) and the county booking rules (county system, 180-day window, 2-night minimum / 4 nights Thu-Sun May 15-Oct 15, walk-ups, 7-night max); season not year-round, closing date given two ways. Fees left as read 2026-10-10. Southaven's own page does NOT say reservations are required for all sites (the Smith Point drop reason). Not stated: amperage, hookups beyond electric, site lengths, showers (derived value left). Note trimmed of field facts and the Green Key line.
flags: Phone: the entry has 631-854-1414; Southaven's own page gives 'General Info (631) 852-1391' (and the parks department's (631) 854-4949). Suggest 631-852-1391.

Non-resident access (the Indian Island / Smith Point drop question): Southaven's own page has no 'reservations are required for all the sites' line. The county rules give walk-ups ('Check-in for available walk-up sites will begin at 8:00 am'; 'Campers must have a valid Green Key Card or pay non-resident rates'), so a non-resident can take an unreserved site as a walk-up, reserve 4+ nights with the $50 Non-Resident Reservation Green Key, or reserve at resident rates with the $200 VIP key. Every reservation needs 2 nights, 4 when it takes in Thursday-Sunday between May 15 and Oct 15.
Household rule: 'Campsite occupancy strictly enforced to a single household residing at same address' (county camping page). Not a single-occupancy rule.
